taxonomy:
Here is a simple single-depth hierarchical taxonomy of grid-based logic games, with each game placed into exactly one of 7 categories and no duplicates:

## 1. Number Placement and Region Filling
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Five Cells
- Juosan
- Nansuke
- Nuritwin
- Suraromu

## 2. Path and Loop Construction
- Hashiwokakero
- Masyu
- Slitherlink
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Numberlink
- Yajilin
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Satogaeri

## 3. Shading and Unshading
- Akari
- Hitori
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Nurikabe
- Nurimeizu
- Norinori
- Tilepaint
- Usowan

## 4. Polyomino and Shape Placement
- LITS
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane
- Pencils
- Sto-stone
- Makaro

## 5. Connectivity and Partition Logic
- Chained Block
- Nuremisaki
- Nansuke
- Yosenabe
- Kurotto
- Nuritwin

## 6. Directional and Visibility Logic
- Nurimisaki
- Moon-or-Sun
- Satogaeri
- Yajilin
- Makaro
- Shakashaka

## 7. Miscellaneous Grid Logic
- Choco Banana
- Fillomino
- Hitori
- Sudoku
- Usowan
- Pencils
